profile.name: George McDermott

profile.name: Chris Chaffee
profile.bio: Chris Chaffee was the Republican nominee for U.S. Senate in Maryland in 2022, receiving about 34 percent of the vote against Chris Van Hollen. He is the Republican nominee for Maryland's 5th Congressional District in 2026.
profile.notes: Commons has File:Chris Chaffee.jpg (CC BY 2.0), but its description names only other attendees of a 2022 event, so it was not used. No campaign site or issue statements were found.

profile.name: Scott M. Collier
profile.bio: Scott M. Collier is the Republican nominee for Maryland's 7th Congressional District in 2026. No further public biographical information was found.

profile.name: Ron Russell
profile.current_role: Retired Army officer and former defense contractor
profile.bio: Ron Russell is a West Point graduate who served 30 years in the U.S. Army, including as a Ranger and Special Forces officer, retiring in 2006. He then built a defense contracting firm and returned to Maine in 2021, living in Kennebunkport. He was the 2024 Republican nominee against Rep. Chellie Pingree.

platform.point: Reduce crime and support first responders.
Lists education as a core campaign priority.
Promote civility, respect and productive debate in Congress.
Campaign issue list also covers immigration, taxes, energy and the economy, guns, and election integrity.

security.evidence: Campaign prioritizes reducing crime and supporting first responders.

profile.notes: The ballot may list him as Ronald Russell; he campaigns as Ron Russell. His issue pages name topics, but detailed positions could not be retrieved.

profile.name: Callie Barr
profile.bio: Callie Barr is the Democratic nominee for Michigan's 1st district. She grew up in Traverse City and Cheboygan and worked as a teacher and veterans advocate before becoming an attorney. Her campaign biography describes her as a military spouse.

platform.point: Unlock federal funding for local affordable homebuilding and reform zoning to add supply.
Make the wealthy pay their fair share, protect Social Security and expand rural broadband.
End tariffs that hurt farmers, support food banks and reverse SNAP cuts.
Protect rural hospitals and Medicaid, extend ACA subsidies and lower drug costs.

economy.evidence: Calls for higher taxes on the wealthy, lifting the Social Security cap and passing the PRO Act.

welfare.evidence: Wants to protect Medicaid, extend ACA subsidies, add a public option and reverse SNAP cuts.

profile.notes: No campaign social media accounts were found on the campaign site.

profile.name: Ethan Baker
profile.bio: Ethan Baker has been mayor of Troy, Michigan, since 2019, after being elected to the Troy City Council in 2015. He moved to Oakland County about 17 years ago and describes himself as a nonpartisan-minded leader.

platform.point: Reduce national division by listening and engaging across differences.
Rebuild public confidence in how government institutions work.
Keep communities safe and expand economic opportunity for families.

profile.notes: The campaign site lists broad themes but no specific policy positions.

profile.name: T.P. Nykoriak
profile.bio: T.P. (Taras) Nykoriak is the Republican nominee for Michigan's 13th congressional district. He has run for office several times before.
profile.notes: No campaign website or published policy positions were found.

profile.name: Benjamin Ambrose
profile.bio: Ben Ambrose won the Democratic nomination for Michigan's 2nd Congressional District in August 2026. He grew up on a farm in Hesperia, Michigan, and served nearly 20 years as a Marine Corps infantryman.

platform.point: Make everyday life more affordable for working families.
Support military veterans and those who served.

welfare.evidence: Lists championing Medicare for All among his campaign priorities.

profile.notes: Most campaign priorities are stated as headings without detail.
